facts.label: Passivo no passado
facts.sub: Singular: was fixed. Plural: were fixed. Quem fez: by + pessoa. Pergunta: Was it painted? Were they changed?

facts.label: Singular no passado
facts.sub: Use was + particípio para dizer o que foi feito com algo no singular: The kitchen was painted. The window was replaced. Em português, é “foi pintada” e “foi trocada”. O foco fica no objeto.

facts.label: Plural no passado
facts.sub: Com plural, use were + particípio: The curtains were washed. The keys were changed. Não misture was com plural. Compare: The window was fixed, mas The windows were fixed.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The past passive uses was or were + participle.

items.why: We say: The kitchen was painted.

items.s: With plural nouns, we use were.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The past passive uses was or were + participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “The kitchen was paint”. → Falso (We say: The kitchen was painted.)
With plural nouns, we use were. → Verdadeiro (Yes: The curtains were washed.)

pages.title: A renovated apartment in Seattle · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy morning in Seattle. Ana is looking for a new place to live. Her friend Cleo has an apartment near the lake. The building is old, but it looks clean. Ana climbs the stairs with a smile. She wants to know everything about the place.

“Welcome to the apartment, Ana. The kitchen was painted last month.” says Cleo. “It looks great. Was the old window changed too?” says Ana. “Yes, it was replaced in March. The glass was broken by a storm.” says Cleo.
